rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Having considered the candidacy for Chairman of the Government submitted by the President, the State Duma, citing Articles 103(1)(a) and 111 of the Constitution, consents to the President's appointment of Viktor Alekseyevich Zubkov as Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation; the resolution is sent to the President and enters into force on adoption. Signed B. V. Gryzlov, Chairman of the State Duma, Moscow, 14 September 2007, No. 5066-4 GD.
rows.locator: Title; preamble; points 1-3; signature and date block
